probes.source: import {createRequire} from 'node:module';import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';const root='${OWLAPI_SOURCE}';const scratch=process.argv[2];process.env.TEMP=scratch+'/temporary';process.env.TMP=process.env.TEMP;const req=createRequire(root+'/package.json');const pw=req('playwright');const {OWLOntologyLoaderConfiguration}=await import(pathToFileURL(root+'/model/owlOntologyLoaderConfiguration.js'));const config=new OWLOntologyLoaderConfiguration();const results={};const allowed=new Set(['internal/parsing/xml/xmlParserAdapter.js','internal/parsing/xml/xmlEntityPolicy.js','internal/parsing/xml/xmlNames.js','internal/parsing/xml/xmlEntityDefaults.js','io/errors.js','internal/profiles/budget.js','internal/modularity/localityBudget.js']);const cases=[['valid','<r/>'],['duplicate-attribute','<r a="1" a="2"/>'],['empty-prefix','<r xmlns:p=""><p:c/></r>']];for(const name of ['chromium','webkit']){const browser=await pw[name].launch({headless:true,timeout:10000});try{const page=await browser.newPage();const requests=[];const blocked=[];await page.route('**/*',async route=>{const u=new URL(route.request().url());const p=u.pathname.substring(1);if(u.host!=='owlapi-probe.invalid'||!allowed.has(p)){blocked.push(u.href);await route.abort();return;}requests.push(p);await route.fulfill({status:200,headers:{'access-control-allow-origin':'*','content-type':'text/javascript'},body:await readFile(root+'/'+p,'utf8')});});await page.setContent('<!doctype html><iframe></iframe>');results[name]=await page.evaluate(async({cases,config})=>{const {xmlParserAdapter}=await import('https://owlapi-probe.invalid/internal/parsing/xml/xmlParserAdapter.js');const {createProfileBudget}=await import('https://owlapi-probe.invalid/internal/profiles/budget.js');const {createLocalityBudget}=await import('https://owlapi-probe.invalid/internal/modularity/localityBudget.js');const xml=[];for(const[id,text]of cases){try{const d=await xmlParserAdapter.parseXml(text,config);xml.push({id,result:'OK',root:d.documentElement.localName,descendantParserErrors:d.getElementsByTagName('parsererror').length});}catch(e){xml.push({id,result:e.name,code:e.code});}}const signals={native:new AbortController().signal,crossRealm:new(document.querySelector('iframe').contentWindow.AbortController)().signal,duck:{aborted:false}};const budgets=[];for(const [id,signal]of Object.entries(signals))for(const[k,f]of [['profile',createProfileBudget],['locality',createLocalityBudget]]){try{f({signal});budgets.push({id,kind:k,result:'OK'});}catch(e){budgets.push({id,kind:k,result:e.name});}}return{xml,budgets};},{cases,config});results[name].fulfilledLocalModules=requests;results[name].blockedRequests=blocked;}finally{await browser.close();}}console.log(JSON.stringify(results));
